title: Creamy Thai Curry Bowl
description: A flavorful and aromatic bowl filled with creamy Thai curry, served over a bed of steamed rice.

ingredients.name: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a vegetarian curry paste

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the chopped onion and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until translucent.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil.
Serve the creamy Thai curry over steamed jasmine rice.
Garnish with additional Thai basil, if desired.
